cafes.headline: Know which table walked out unhappy
cafes.intro: A cafe lives on repeat visits, so a slow order or a cold flat white costs more than one sale. Most of that feedback arrives in reviews and messages you only see days later. BrandPulse pulls it together and tells you what actually needs a reply today.

detect.title: Detect the complaints
detect.text: Angry reviews and messages are scored for sentiment and flagged as complaints, while a simple “the latte was great” is left alone.

group.title: Group them into incident threads
group.text: Ten mentions about the same slow weekend collapse into one incident instead of ten notifications.

alert.title: Alert with a priority score
alert.text: A repeat complaint from a regular customer rises above a one-off grumble, so your shift lead sees it first.

alert.title: 6 mentions about slow service at the Nizami branch
alert.detail: Six negative mentions in the last 24 hours mention waiting times over 20 minutes. Five are in Azerbaijani, one in Russian.
alert.reply: Hello! Sorry about the wait — we have passed this on to our team. We would like to serve you faster next time.

online-shops.headline: Catch the order problems before they turn into refunds
online-shops.intro: For an online shop, a damaged parcel or a stalled return is a lost customer and a public review at the same time. BrandPulse collects what shoppers say and groups repeated issues so you can fix the process, not just the one complaint you happened to see.

detect.title: Detect the complaints
detect.text: Reviews, comments and messages are read in English, Azerbaijani and Russian, and the unhappy ones are flagged automatically.

group.title: Group them into incident threads
group.text: A batch of “wrong size” reports becomes a single sizing incident, so you can see it is a pattern rather than bad luck.

alert.title: Alert with a priority score
alert.text: A refund thread that keeps growing outranks a single slow-delivery note and lands at the top of your inbox.

alert.title: Refund delays mentioned 11 times this week
alert.detail: Eleven mentions describe refunds taking more than ten days. Three use the words “never replied”. Mixed EN, AZ and RU.
alert.reply: Thank you for flagging this — refunds should not take this long. We are checking your order now and will confirm the status today.

delivery.headline: See the routes that generate the complaints
delivery.intro: Delivery problems are loud: parcels left in the rain, orders marked delivered that never arrive. They are also repetitive, which is exactly what BrandPulse is good at spotting — the same courier, the same zone, the same wording, grouped into one thread.

detect.title: Detect the complaints
detect.text: Delivery language has its own vocabulary — “not received”, “left outside”, “gəlmədi” — and the analyser is tuned for it.

group.title: Group them into incident threads
group.text: Every “left outside” report in one district is merged, so you can see whether it is one courier or a whole shift.

alert.title: Alert with a priority score
alert.text: Lost parcels score higher than late ones, so the cases that need compensation get attention before they escalate.

alert.title: “Left outside” reports up in one district
alert.detail: Five mentions in two days describe parcels left at the door without a call. All five are from the same delivery zone.
alert.reply: We are sorry your parcel was left unattended. We have flagged this delivery zone and will call before reattempting delivery.

clinics.headline: Turn quiet dissatisfaction into a booked follow-up
clinics.intro: A late appointment or an unclear bill rarely ends up in a formal complaint — it ends up in a review three weeks later, or nowhere at all. BrandPulse surfaces those signals while there is still time to reach out and win the client back.

detect.title: Detect the complaints
detect.text: Billing and waiting-time complaints are picked out from routine feedback, even in short informal messages.

group.title: Group them into incident threads
group.text: Repeated complaints about the same reception hours become one thread you can act on with the team.

alert.title: Alert with a priority score
alert.text: Money-related and strongly worded complaints are ranked first so they are answered the same day.

alert.title: Billing complaint needs a same-day reply
alert.detail: A client says they were charged for a service they did not receive. Marked strongly negative and grouped with two similar notes.
alert.reply: Thank you for telling us. We are reviewing the invoice with the front desk today and will call you with a correction.

hotels.headline: Answer the review before it defines your season
hotels.intro: For a hotel, one bad review can outweigh twenty good ones. BrandPulse reads the review sites and messages your guests actually use, in their own language, and points out the recurring themes — rooms, breakfast, transfers — that quietly shape your rating.

detect.title: Detect the complaints
detect.text: Reviews and messages in EN, AZ and RU are scored, so a Russian review does not sit unanswered at the bottom of a list.

group.title: Group them into incident threads
group.text: Everything about the same weekend or the same room type is merged, showing you the story behind the score.

alert.title: Alert with a priority score
alert.text: Safety, cleanliness and transport failures reach the top so the duty manager sees them before check-in.

alert.title: Cleanliness mentioned in 4 reviews this month
alert.detail: Four reviews across two languages mention housekeeping. Rating impact is concentrated on one floor.
alert.reply: Thank you for the honest feedback. We have asked housekeeping to review this floor today and would be glad to welcome you again.

agencies.headline: Protect your clients' reputation while you sleep
agencies.intro: Agencies get blamed for complaints about their clients, and often hear about them from the client first. BrandPulse gives you the same picture in advance, across several projects, so you can send the heads-up instead of receiving it.

detect.title: Detect the complaints
detect.text: Each client project has its own stream, so feedback about one brand never blurs into another.

group.title: Group them into incident threads
group.text: Comments about the same campaign are grouped, which makes the weekly client update far quicker to write.

alert.title: Alert with a priority score
alert.text: Anything with strong language or a growing thread is pushed to you first, before your client finds it.

alert.title: Growing thread about response times
alert.detail: Five mentions across three days criticise slow replies. Two are from accounts with a large following.
alert.reply: Thanks for the nudge — we have restructured how requests are triaged and will share the new response plan this week.
